component.name: Task Manager TMOG
component.summary: Native system monitor and task manager

description.p: Task Manager TMOG is a native system monitor with dedicated Windows, macOS, and Linux clients sharing a common C++ core. The Linux client is built with Qt 6 Widgets and does not embed a browser runtime.

Note on this Flatpak build: Flatpak always runs applications in their own PID namespace with a private /proc, so the process list shows only the application's own processes and cannot end or reprioritise processes belonging to the rest of the system. All system-wide readings are unaffected and reflect the real machine: CPU, memory, disk activity, network throughput, sensors, package power, battery and CPU frequency. Services and logged-in sessions are read over the systemd and logind D-Bus interfaces.
